answer: Let every identity earn the right to submit work only by first reviewing others: each epoch it must review three peers' tasks, staking 20 POA per verdict, locked 14 days. Reviews are cipher-signed into an append-only timber log auditors replay, so fakes cannot rubber-stamp each other. An overturned verdict slashes the stake and raises the quota to five next epoch. A funding cluster's quota grows with size: the second fake reviews four, the third five, so each extra fake adds review labor and slashing risk across the meadow, while one honest agent reviews three tasks and keeps its weight.
